contributing code or artwork to an open-source game
summary.what_it_does: ["0 A.D. (pronounced 'zero ey-dee') is described as a free, open-source, cross-platform real-time strategy game of ancient warfare. The page states it is an incomplete, under-development version. The Gitea repository hosts development info and the bug tracker. Precompiled Windows builds are available from the nightly-build SVN repository, with the game launched via pyrogenesis.exe and the map editor via Atlas.bat or pyrogenesis.exe -editor. Build instructions for Windows, Linux and OS X are linked. Contributors can find guides for programmers, artists and translators (via Transifex)."]
notable: Map editor (Atlas) bundled with the game
Source code under MIT/GPL-2.0/Zlib licenses per awesome-selfhosted listing
caveats: Described as an incomplete, under-development version of the game
Windows precompiled build comes from the nightly-build SVN repository; git users must follow compile steps
